source.notes: ICSE Class IX school half-yearly examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'Half Yearly Examination 2016-2017', 'Std. : IX', 'Subject : MATHEMATICS', 'Full Marks : 80', 'Time : 2½ Hrs.+15mins.'; examYear 2017 is the later year of the printed session (also the year in the file name). durationMinutes 165 = 2½ h + 15 min as printed. The PDF has no text layer (watermark only); text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against the page images. Section A (40 marks, attempt all) has Q1-Q4; Section B (40 marks, attempt any four) prints seven questions Q5-Q11 of 10 marks each, so the pack's marks add up to more than 80. Every sub-part carries a printed mark and is its own entry. Powers and fractions were rebuilt from the page images. Figures (Q2 b, Q7 b, Q8 a, Q9 a, Q9 b) are not reproduced. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.

questions.text: Find the value of a if the distance between the points A (–3, –14) and B (a, –5) is 9 units.

2. Reflect A,B,C, on x = O to A' B' C'. Write the coordinates of A' B' C'.
